text: Council Member City of Westminster
You Voted for Me. I Delivered for You.
When I asked for your vote, I made promises. As your District 4 Councilmember, I delivered on them.
I supported hiring more police officers and continue advocating for additional officers, park rangers—answering residents’ call for safer neighborhoods, schools, and parks.
I helped restore Westminster’s financial strength. For the first time in over a decade, our city has more than $60 million in reserves—a milestone that protects essential services.
I pushed for road repairs, cleaner streets, and improved landscaping—improvements residents can see and appreciate.
I cut red tape for small businesses, helping shops and restaurants open, grow, and create local jobs.
I championed Safe Routes to School, youth scholarships, stronger city-school partnerships, and police protection for our schools—investments valued by parents and families.
I supported our city shelter, connecting people experiencing homelessness with housing, mental-health services, and job training—a practical solution welcomed by residents.

Westminster is my home. You trusted me, and I delivered. These results reflect the priorities of our community. I respectfully ask for your vote to continue building a safer, cleaner, and more prosperous Westminster.
Vote NamQuan Nguyen for Westminster City Council, District 4.

text: Businesswoman
I am a proud Vietnamese American, a business owner, an MBA graduate, and a community advocate.

My priorities are public safety, supporting our police and fire departments, assisting small businesses succeed, assisting with relocating the homeless off the streets into supportive services, supporting financial transparency and ensuring your tax dollars are spent in the best interest of Westminster.

Since 2012, I have helped immigrant residents’ access food assistance and other essential programs. I have legally assisted thousands of people to learn English, complete citizenship applications, family sponsorship, and other lawful immigration services. I also support homeless individuals and connect them with available community resources.
I volunteer as Chief of Staff for a civilian nonprofit supporting the U.S. Armed Forces through military funeral honors for veterans and disaster relief efforts too.
These extensive experiences have equipped me with strong planning, budgeting, and resource management skills to serve Westminster with integrity, transparency, and fiscal responsibility.
As your City Council Member, I will protect our resident`s quality of life by investing in our streets, parks and public spaces while supporting business growth and responsible government.
Let us build a Safer, Stronger Westminster!
Thank you for your consideration, support, and vote.
Kelly Daniels

text: Business Owner/Administrator

It’s time to restore independent leadership and accountable government in Westminster.
For too long, City Hall has been influenced by political factions, special interests, and personal agendas. I am running as an independent candidate because I believe every decision should be based on what is best for our residents—not on political alliances or predetermined outcomes.

As your Councilmember, I will listen to the people, carefully review the facts, seek expert advice, and make decisions that protect Westminster’s long-term interests. I believe every taxpayer deserves an honest, transparent government that spends public funds responsibly, respects the law, and remains accountable to the community.
I will support open meetings, encourage meaningful public participation, and ensure every resident has the opportunity to be heard. Our City employees and professional staff should be allowed to do their jobs without unnecessary political interference. I will not serve any political organization, special-interest group, or individual. My loyalty will be to the residents of Westminster alone. I will vote my conscience, protect taxpayer dollars, strengthen public trust, and work to improve public safety, city services, and our quality of life.
If elected, I will be an independent voice, an advocate for transparency, and your watchdog at City Hall.

text: Financial Consultant

My husband and I have called Westminster home for 35 years, raising our three sons here through local public schools: a CPA, an Army Captain and dentist, and a violinist. As a mother, small business owner, and community advocate, I will bring people together to restore civility, solve problems, and deliver results.

They say gray hair comes with experience, and after a 40-year financial career, including 28 years as a Financial Controller managing diverse teams and multi-million-dollar budgets, I will put that experience to work for you. As a Chapman University Executive MBA graduate who earned a CPA license, I will strengthen fiscal accountability at City Hall. I regularly attend City Council meetings to monitor city spending and advocate for residents.
My "Make Westminster Shine" initiative focuses on:
Ensuring fiscal responsibility by scrutinizing city spending and prioritizing neighborhood needs.
Supporting seniors and mobile home residents through housing stability and rent stabilization.
Expanding youth programs and safe after-school care for local families.
Driving economic growth and addressing homelessness responsibly.

Westminster deserves prepared, accountable, responsive leadership that listens to residents and delivers results. Learn more at voteloannguyen.com. I respectfully ask for your vote for City Council, District 4.
